title: Satellite onboarding toolchain probe should not require an undocumented host rustc installation
outcome: Satellite onboarding toolchain probe should not require an undocumented host rustc installation
acceptance: An operator-provisioned TermAl satellite can report its configured build/toolchain identity without an undocumented host-installed rustc dependency, or the supported prerequisite is explicitly specified and verified.
A failed toolchain measurement is reported as a named version/platform probe failure rather than an authenticated forward-RPC failure.
Focused regression coverage exercises the supported host-toolchain prerequisite and its named failure path.
